boundary.finding: An input feature marked mandatory=false could be the sole kept capability for a must goal, yet its isolated placement still passed because MISSING_GOAL checked only goal and role membership.
boundary.fix: Move the MISSING_GOAL coverage check after role-specific entry reachability is available. Require at least one kept feature for the must goal and its role to have a placement reachable from an authorized entry.
limits: The rule is existential: another reachable capability for the same must goal is sufficient.
It does not make every optional feature associated with that goal mandatory.
A should goal does not trigger this must-goal capability check.
The previous mandatory-input-feature reachability check and direct-merge check remain in place.
No requirement that the usable capability be located on the goal route's selected target is added.

test_fixture_role: Hand-authored contract fixture mutations, not benchmark or independently generated model outputs.
